title: Liquid clustering on a column past the 32nd fails the first update
symptom: DELTA_CLUSTERING_COLUMN_MISSING_STATS on a wide table's first update
cause: Delta collects stats for the first 32 columns; with many sources the key starts with _source, which silver puts last
effect: Wide tables fail in an n:1 silver
fix: Set delta.dataSkippingStatsColumns: the clustering columns first (not BINARY or BOOLEAN)
